title: Wearing Winter Clothes in Spring
synopsis: Don't be in a rush to put all your winter clothes into the wardrobe.

fullText.simplified:
春天也需要穿冬装

    春天来了，天气转暖，你是不是已经拿出了所有的春装？不过，先别着急把冬装都放进衣柜里，因为你可能还会需要穿一些厚衣服。
    春天是一年中天气变化最无常的季节，可能前一天还是二十度的大晴天，第二天就开始下雪。于是就会出现今天穿衬衫，明天穿羽绒服的情况。俗话说，“春天孩儿脸，一天变三变”。在春天，一天中的温差也非常大，中午常常会比早上和晚上热十几度。所以出门前一定要记得看天气预报，及时换衣服，不然很容易感冒。
    有一个词叫“春捂秋冻”，意思就是春天不要太着急把厚衣服都脱了，因为天气很可能还会变冷；秋天也不要天一冷就穿上厚衣服，让身体开始习惯低温，这样才能更好地适应冬天的寒冷天气。
fullText.traditional:
春天也需要穿冬裝

    春天來了，天氣轉暖，你是不是已經拿出了所有的春裝？不過，先別著急把冬裝都放進衣櫃裡，因為你可能還會需要穿一些厚衣服。
    春天是一年中天氣變化最無常的季節，可能前一天還是二十度的大晴天，第二天就開始下雪。於是就會出現今天穿襯衫，明天穿羽絨服的情況。俗話說，“春天孩兒臉，一天變三變”。在春天，一天中的溫差也非常大，中午常常會比早上和晚上熱十幾度。所以出門前一定要記得看天氣預報，及時換衣服，不然很容易感冒。
    有一個詞叫“春捂秋凍”，意思就是春天不要太著急把厚衣服都脫了，因為天氣很可能還會變冷；秋天也不要天一冷就穿上厚衣服，讓身體開始習慣低溫，這樣才能更好地適應冬天的寒冷天氣。

sentences.simplified: 让身体开始习惯低温，这样才能更好地适应冬天的寒冷天气。

sentences.english: You should also not put on your thick clothes immediately when the weather gets colder in autumn.
Let your body get used to the low temperature. This way you will better adapt to the cold weather during winter.

raw.synopsis: Don't be in a rush to put all your winter clothes into the wardrobe.
sentence_translations: It is spring now, and the weather is getting warmer. Have you taken out all of your spring clothes?
However, don’t be in a rush to put all your winter clothes into the wardrobe, ..
.. because you may still need to wear thick clothes.
Spring is the season with the most abrupt weather changes.
It might be sunny and 20 degrees one day, but snowy the next.
So we might wear a shirt one day, and a feather down coat the next.
As the saying goes: “Spring is like a baby's face, it changes three times a day.”
In spring, the temperature difference during the day can also be very big.
It is often more than 10 degrees warmer at noon than in the morning or evening.
Therefore we must remember to check the weather forecast before going out, and change clothes accordingly.
Otherwise it is easy to catch a cold.
There is a phrase called “Wear more clothes during spring and less in autumn”.
It means you shouldn't rush to take off your thick clothes when spring comes, ..
.. because the weather may turn cold again.
You should also not put on your thick clothes immediately when the weather gets colder in autumn.
Let your body get used to the low temperature. This way you will better adapt to the cold weather during winter.
